description.en: In-game bank with loans, fixed-term investments, credit score, dynamic credit limit and automatic monthly payments. Press ALT+B on foot to open.
description.pt: Banco dentro do jogo com emprestimos, investimentos a prazo, score de credito, limite dinamico e pagamentos mensais automaticos. Pressione ALT+B a pe para abrir.
